slaughter: Act.8:32 (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rom.8:36 (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, Jas.5:5.†

elsewhere.note: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t…
Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
